description: Get historical daily Frankfurter v1 rates for a currency pair over an inclusive date range. Rates use same-date EUR legs without intermediate rounding; only days with both currencies appear, and a self-pair is 1 on actual observation dates. Historical membership includes retired currencies. Empty non-publication windows succeed with a notice. summary covers every observation in the requested interval before paging or staging: unweighted arithmetic mean, extrema with earliest-date ties, endpoints and percentage change, without prescribing accounting policy. Inline rates page at 500 observations; continue with next_start_date and the same end_date. Long ranges (>90 days by default) stage when they exceed the 40,000-character preview budget. An explicit canvas_id always stages, including short or empty ranges, and fails if unavailable or unknown. Each registration returns a unique table_name and preserves older tables. spilled=true returns canvas_id and table_name; call fx_dataframe_describe then fx_dataframe_query for SQL. Without DataCanvas, omit canvas_id to page inline.

base_currency.description: ISO 4217 base currency code (e.g. USD). Call fx_list_currencies to get valid codes.

canvas_id.description: Existing canvas ID from a prior call explicitly requesting staging even for short or empty results. Every call creates a uniquely named table. Omit for automatic staging or inline paging.

end_date.description: ISO 8601 end date (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be >= start_date. Future dates are not supported.

quote_currency.description: ISO 4217 quote currency code (e.g. EUR). Call fx_list_currencies to get valid codes.

start_date.description: ISO 8601 start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Frankfurter v1 data starts 1999-01-04. The actual first data point may be later if start_date falls on a weekend/holiday.

name: fx_get_timeseries

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID — present when spilled is true. Pass to fx_dataframe_describe to inspect the staged table, then to fx_dataframe_query to run SQL.

end_date.description: Last publication date in the requested range. Always inside the requested range — earlier than the requested end when that day had no Frankfurter v1 fix, and equal to it when the series is empty. Later than the last key in rates when truncated is true.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_date_format`: start_date or end_date is not a real calendar date written as YYYY-MM-DD. `unsupported_currency`: base_currency or quote_currency is not available in the current discovery or served historical data. `date_out_of_range`: start_date is before 1999-01-04 or end_date is in the future. `invalid_range`: start_date is after end_date. `upstream_no_data`: Both currencies are supported but the Frankfurter v1 published no rates across this range. `canvas_not_found`: An explicitly supplied canvas_id does not exist or has expired. `canvas_unavailable`: canvas_id requests staging on a deployment with DataCanvas disabled. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

next_start_date.description: Present only when an inline page was cut short: the first publication date not in rates. Pass it as start_date with the same end_date to get the next page. Absent on the final page.

notice.description: Explains a result that would otherwise look broken or incomplete: an empty series (no publication day in the range); an inline page cut short (the start_date to continue from, plus why a long range was not staged when DataCanvas is turned off); or a spilled series (the canvas and table it was staged to, and the tools that read it).

rate_count.description: Total publication days in the requested range (the start_date through end_date passed on this call) — not the number of entries in rates, which is smaller when truncated is true. On a continuation call it counts the days from that start_date onward.

rate_type.description: Always "Daily rate (Frankfurter v1)" — these are reference rates, not tradeable bid/ask.

rates.description: Date → rate map in date order, publication days inside the requested range only. Holds every publication day when truncated is false; otherwise the first 500 of an inline page (continue with next_start_date) or the preview of a spilled series (the full series is on the canvas). Empty when the range contains no publication day at all.

source.description: Always "Frankfurter v1" — the upstream data provider.

spilled.description: True when the complete result was staged on DataCanvas, either explicitly through canvas_id or automatically after exceeding the threshold and preview budget.

start_date.description: First publication date in the requested range, and the first key in rates. Always inside the requested range — later than the requested start when that day had no Frankfurter v1 fix, and equal to it when the series is empty.

summary.description: Statistics over the full clipped requested range before paging or staging; omitted for empty ranges. Continuations summarize their own requested interval.

change_pct.description: Percentage change from first to last observation.

date.description: Earliest date with the highest rate.

mean.description: Unweighted arithmetic mean of all daily observations in the requested range; not an accounting-policy prescription.

date.description: Earliest date with the lowest rate.

table_name.description: Canvas table name — present when spilled is true. Use it as the FROM target in fx_dataframe_query SQL; fx_dataframe_describe lists its columns.

truncated.description: True when rates holds only part of the series: an inline page (next_start_date continues it) or a spilled preview (spilled is true). False when rates holds every publication day in the requested range.

title: Fx Get Timeseries
